import datetime
def occ_h(ts):
    d = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
    return d.weekday() < 5 and 9 <= d.hour <= 16

split = '2018-06-15'
def stats(series):
    before = [(t,v) for t,v in data[series] if t < split and occ_h(t)]
    after = [(t,v) for t,v in data[series] if t >= split and occ_h(t)]
    def m(l): return sum(v for _,v in l)/len(l) if l else None
    return m(before), m(after), len(before), len(after)

for name, sid in list(sensors.items())+list(setpts.items()):
    b,a,nb,na = stats(sid)
    print(name, 'before=%.3f after=%.3f delta=%.3f (n=%d,%d)' % (b,a,a-b,nb,na))
